description: Shipped OpenZL compressors for openzl-express (Phase 3). Built with zli train from sample corpora.

serial.description: Opaque byte stream (ACE+LZ). Safe default for any payload.

timeseries.description: Trained on numeric time-series JSON (corpus B shape).

api-list.description: Trained on repetitive REST list JSON (corpus A shape).

prose.description: Trained on prose-heavy JSON (corpus C). Expect little gain vs serial.

binary.description: Trained on fixed-width binary records (corpus F).

binary-le-u32.description: Trained le-u32 profile on fixed-width binary (best ratio on typed binary).
